initial_decision.brief_rationale: The supplied table and numerical checks establish a computed contrast but provide no causal identification assumptions. Request archived design record R217-2 to assess whether the average causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R217-2 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity, identifying the causal effect by standardization over Z. Population stratum weights are 0.4 and 0.6; stratum risk differences are -0.1 and 0.3. Thus the average causal risk difference is 0.4(-0.1) + 0.6(0.3) = 0.14.
